newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania rollover T-bills slightly oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Romania rollover T-bills slightly oversubscribed.

text.p: Romania's central bank said on Thursday the Finance Ministry's 105-day treasury bill issue was slightly oversubscribed with banks' bids exceeding a 532.29 billion lei offer by some 80 million lei.
The rollover bills, maturing on January 9, 1997, were offered with a coupon giving an annual yield of 50.33 percent.

Seven banks -- Banca Romana de Comert Exterior Bancorex SA, Banca de Credit Cooperatist Bankcoop SA, Banca Agricola SA, Banca Romana pentru Dezvoltare SA, Banca Ion Tiriac SA, Banca Turco-Romana SA and Banca Comerciala Romana SA -- and their corporate clients bought the new T-bills. ($=3,246 lei) -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
